### Summary of Submission

* **Repository:** https://github.com/[owner]/[repo]
* **Lifecycle Stage / Category:** (e.g. Stage 1: Ingress & Routing / Stage 3: Tool Gating / Open-Weight Models)
* **Decision Primitive Used:** [`Choice` / `Noul` / `Score` / `/v1/systemone` wire protocol / Other]
* **Current Stars:** [e.g. 150]
* **License:** [e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0]

### Proposed Entry Format

```markdown
* [owner/repo](https://github.com/owner/repo) (★<stars>) - Short, objective description of what it does and why it matters.
```

### Quality Checklist

- [ ] Repository has readable documentation, installation instructions, and working examples.
- [ ] No marketing superlatives or unbacked claims (objective, technical phrasing only).
- [ ] Conforms to the 100% English requirement of `awesome-jev`.
- [ ] Placed in the correct section/stage in `README.md` or relevant `catalog/` file.
- [ ] Follows the standard Markdown format: `* [name](url) (★stars) - Description.`
